# Material Ocean

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-ocean)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-ocean)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-ocean)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-ocean)

Material Ocean is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Material family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-ocean codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `materialOcean` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { materialOcean } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-ocean';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, materialOcean],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `materialOcean` | `Extension` |
| `materialOceanMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#0f111a` |
| Active line | `#08090d` |
| Selection | `#212537` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.53:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#C792EA` | bold | 7.83:1 | 8.27:1 | 6.30:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#C792EA` | bold | 7.83:1 | 8.27:1 | 6.30:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#89DDFF` | - | 12.42:1 | 13.13:1 | 10.00:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#868ca0` | - | 5.62:1 | 5.94:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#f07178` | - | 6.58:1 | 6.95:1 | 5.30:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#82AAFF` | - | 8.20:1 | 8.66:1 | 6.60:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#82AAFF` | - | 8.20:1 | 8.66:1 | 6.60:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#C792EA` | - | 7.83:1 | 8.27:1 | 6.30:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#DECB6B` | - | 11.53:1 | 12.19:1 | 9.29:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#DECB6B` | italic | 11.53:1 | 12.19:1 | 9.29:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#C792EA` | italic | 7.83:1 | 8.27:1 | 6.30:1 |
| String | `string` | `#C3E88D` | - | 13.67:1 | 14.45:1 | 11.01:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#F78C6C` | - | 8.00:1 | 8.46:1 | 6.44:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#FF5370` | - | 6.03:1 | 6.37:1 | 4.86:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#F78C6C` | - | 8.00:1 | 8.46:1 | 6.44:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#f07178` | - | 6.58:1 | 6.95:1 | 5.30:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#868ca0` | italic | 5.62:1 | 5.94:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#868ca0` | - | 5.62:1 | 5.94:1 | 4.53:1 |

| Heading | `heading` | `#80CBC4` | bold | 10.09:1 | 10.67:1 | 8.13:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | `#C3E88D` | italic | 13.67:1 | 14.45:1 | 11.01:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#9599a8` | background, active line, selection | 5.34:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#868ca0` | gutter | 5.62:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#FFCC00` | background, active line | 12.45:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#89ddff` | background | 12.42:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #82AAFF` | background, active line | 8.20:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#89DDFF, 1px solid #89DDFF` | background (fill or outline) | 12.42:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#717cb430` | active line | 1.31:1 | Pass |
